latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Connect with TikTok creators for viral content and trending campaigns.

- Offers example API calls to browse creators and post TikTok campaign tasks with specific viral objectives.

- Designed to maximize TikTok brand visibility and campaign performance through proven, platform-native strategies.
